card.name: Published books and copyright lines
card.fires_on: The word 'collection' (also 'volume of', 'book', 'author of') when a literary work such as poems or stories is being described. It also fires on 'Copyright' and 'from' in permission or credit lines.

modes.label: Collection of writings
modes.description: A word for a published book of poems or stories, such as collection, volume or book, in an author's biography.
modes.example: War I. Tower of Ivory, MacLeish's first<< collection>> of poems, was published not long after

modes.label: Copyright and credit lines
modes.description: The word Copyright, its year, or 'from' in an excerpt permission note.
modes.example: Excerpted with permission<< from>> Random House Canada. All rights reserved.

card.plain: It lights up when text talks about an author's published book or gives a copyright credit.
